scope: Held-out DROID episodes 21/77 ZED calibration v2
summary: The combined RLinf NumPy plus ZED 5.1 runtime opened and processed all three episode-21 SVOs, but final result construction failed because the extractor required the legacy episode_id field instead of the new episode_index lineage schema.
evidence: ZED opened serials 18026681, 22008760, and 24400334 and downloaded their official calibration files.
Depth sample artifacts were written before the final KeyError on download['episode_id'].
episode 77 was not started after the fail-closed episode-21 return code.
lessons: Calibration extraction must normalize both legacy UUID manifests and lineage-mapped episode-index manifests.
limitations: No terminal calibration.json was accepted from this attempt.
next_actions: Resolve episode identity from metadata UUID plus optional episode_index and rerun in a new directory.
